scope: working-tree source verification; independent form and injected draft port, no installation or release claim
overlap: The 30 new tests are included in 53 focused tests and are not additional application coverage.

boundaries.uiHost: VM DOM/host doubles; no real GPU or browser layout claim
boundaries.sourceParsing: existing real portable parser/native WASM used by form fixtures
boundaries.proposalCreation: 29 UI tests inject a proposal double; one mandatory final test uses the real branded portable helper/native WASM
boundaries.applyDraft: injected authoritative editor-memory port double; ordinary Save integration is owned by the parent smoke
boundaries.languages: Chinese/English/Japanese inputs, selection and approval retained in unit tests; screen layout requires separate browser evidence

meaningfulChecks: Explicit subset of position, XYZ Euler degrees and size; no unchecked-field writes
Net unchanged proposal does not approve or apply
Incomplete raw numbers, normal and silent input changes invalidate approval
Silent legal object selection before Check cannot approve another object
Source path/token and asynchronous epoch ownership; close and late reopen isolation
Exact application receipt content/path/new token; legal draft token advance accepted
Cancellation and Escape available during pending operations; late focus ignored
Actual proposal private brand remains intact through review and application

independentReview.description: The independent probe exposed silent object selection before Check; the controller was minimally fixed and a new regression added. The unchanged 9-group probe subsequently passed.
